paragraphs: Creative Minds Network is a learning and assessment hub for CMC students, teachers, and program administrators. The project combines a polished landing page, classroom resources, practice assessments, interactive learning games, and member-focused workflows into a single React + Vite experience.
features: Purpose: Teacher-resource landing page and assessment studio for Creative Minds Network (CMC)
Audience: classroom teachers, students, and learning program staff
Main features: ready-to-use assignments, Kid Program resources for grades 5–12, TOEFL Junior-style assessments, browser games, and Supabase-powered member access flows
Tech stack: React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, HTML, CSS, and PostgreSQL/Supabase integration for member and lead management

whatItDoes.text: Creative Minds Network is a learning and assessment hub for CMC students, teachers, and program administrators. The project combines a polished landing page, classroom resources, practice assessments, interactive learning games, and member-focused workflows into a single React + Vite experience.

requirements.text: No login, no server, no student data leaves the device.
The UI and server code are in place, but live sign-up, mail delivery, database policies, Edge Function deployment, and account deletion must be enabled and tested against your project before launch.
